title: Interaction of Flavonoids with Zinc and Zinc-Containing Enzymes.
authors: Hrubsa, Marcel; Tvrdy, Vaclav; Kuty, Michal; Valentova, Katerina; Kren, Vladimir; Mladenka, Premysl
journal: Journal of agricultural and food chemistry
one_liner_zh: 该文研究黄酮类化合物与锌离子及含锌酶的螯合与抑制，虽涉及锌指转录因子相关金属但非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，仅含简单分子对接且无AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: The current chelation therapy has several drawbacks, including lack of selectivity, which could lead to trace metal depletion. Consequently, the proper function of metalloenzymes can be disrupted. Flavonoids possess chelating properties and hence interfere with the homeostasis of essential metals. We focused on zinc, an important trace metal required for the function of many enzymes and transcription factors. After making an initial evaluation of the Zn(2+)-chelating properties of a series of flavonoids, the effect of these compounds on various zinc-containing enzymes was also investigated. We performed enzyme inhibition assays spectrophotometrically using yeast and equine alcohol dehydrogenases and bovine glutamate dehydrogenase. Nine of the 21 flavonoids tested were capable of chelating Zn(2+). Baicalein and 3-hydroxyflavone were the most potent Zn(2+) chelators under slightly acidic and neutral pH conditions. This chelation was also confirmed by the ability to reverse Zn(2+)-induced enzymatic inhibition of bovine glutamate dehydrogenase. Although some flavonoids were also able to inhibit zinc-containing alcohol dehydrogenases, this inhibition was likely not caused by Zn(2+) chelation. Luteolin was a relatively potent inhibitor of these enzymes regardless of the presence of Zn(2+). Docking studies confirmed the binding of active flavonoids to equine alcohol dehydrogenase without any significant interaction with the catalytic zinc.
abstract_zh: 目前的螯合疗法存在若干缺点，包括缺乏选择性，可能导致微量金属耗竭。因此，金属酶的正常功能可能受到干扰。黄酮类化合物具有螯合特性，从而干扰必需金属的稳态。我们聚焦于锌，这是一种对许多酶和转录因子功能所需的重要微量金属。在对一系列黄酮类化合物的Zn(2+)螯合特性进行初步评估后，还研究了这些化合物对各种含锌酶的影响。我们使用酵母和马肝醇脱氢酶以及牛谷氨酸脱氢酶，通过分光光度法进行了酶抑制测定。所测试的21种黄酮类化合物中，有9种能够螯合Zn(2+)。在微酸性和中性pH条件下，黄芩素和3-羟基黄酮是最有效的Zn(2+)螯合剂。这种螯合作用也通过逆转Zn(2+)诱导的牛谷氨酸脱氢酶酶抑制的能力得到证实。尽管一些黄酮类化合物也能抑制含锌醇脱氢酶，但这种抑制可能并非由Zn(2+)螯合引起。木犀草素是这些酶的相对有效抑制剂，无论是否存在Zn(2+)。对接研究证实了活性黄酮类化合物与马醇脱氢酶的结合，且与催化锌无显著相互作用。
